skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply fundamental concepts of linear algebra, including systems of linear equations, matrices, determinants, vector spaces, and linear mappings.
Develop logical reasoning and problem-solving skills through mathematical concepts and operations.
Analyze and solve problems in economics, business, and science using mathematical models.
Enhance self-study and research capabilities, fostering independent and collaborative work habits.
Apply mathematical concepts to economic models and market analysis.
